scope: Actual WorldFolderView/FolderTheme executed in isolated real Chromium DOM. Reader/callbacks are declared fixtures; no Creator gameplay or catalog persistence claim.

checks.name: D01 dynamic metadata card list has one built-in ID, distinct data identities and exact open callback routing
D02 metadata and account text remain escaped rather than executing or creating HTML nodes
D03 destroy/re-mount refreshes current reader data, removes prior card handlers and avoids duplicate view roots
D04 empty initialized account displays no seeded cards while editor navigation remains available
D05 actual form creates through real director port, refreshes cards and resets controls only after success
D06 delete requires confirmation, cancel writes nothing, failed delete keeps visible record, successful delete tombstones
D07 real fork intent displays unavailable message without creating record; refresh delegates current-reader reload
